```json
  "textEditContent": "# GULFARA - Strategic Product Overview\n\n## Executive Summary\n\n**Gulfara** is a production-ready, AI-powered adaptive flashcard platform for learning Gulf Arabic. It's a **full-stack web application** (frontend + serverless backend) that combines evidence-based learning techniques with modern gamification to create an engaging, personalized language learning experience.\n\n### Product Category\n- **Type:** Educational SaaS / Language Learning Platform\n- **Target User:** Gulf Arabic learners (professionals, expats, heritage learners)\n- **Delivery Model:** Web-based, responsive, mobile-friendly\n- **Deployment:** Vercel (serverless) + Supabase (cloud database)\n\n---\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n### 🎯 Is This Frontend or Backend? **BOTH - Full-Stack**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                    FRONTEND (React)                          │\n│  - React 18 + TypeScript + Vite                             │\n│  - Client-side UI/UX, real-time learning interface          │\n│  - Deployed on Vercel Edge Network                          │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                              ↓\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│              BACKEND APIs (Node.js Serverless)              │\n│  - api/sync.ts - Vercel Functions                           │\n│  - Data synchronization and server-side operations          │\n│  - Authentication middleware                                │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                              ↓\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│           EXTERNAL SERVICES (Integration Layer)             │\n│  - Supabase (PostgreSQL Database)                           │\n│  - Clerk (User Authentication)                              │\n│  - OpenAI (AI Difficulty Adaptation)                        │\n│  - Vercel (Hosting + Serverless Functions)                  │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Technology Stack\n\n### Frontend Layer\n| Component | Technology | Purpose |\n|-----------|-----------|---------|\n| **UI Framework** | React 18 | Component-based UI |\n| **Language** | TypeScript | Type-safe development |\n| **Build Tool** | Vite | Fast dev server &amp; optimized builds |\n| **Styling** | TailwindCSS | Utility-first CSS |\n| **UI Components** | Radix UI | Accessible, headless components |\n| **Animations** | Framer Motion | Smooth 3D card flips &amp; transitions |\n| **Charts** | Recharts | Progress analytics visualization |\n| **Routing** | React Router | Multi-page navigation |\n| **State Management** | React Context + React Query | Global state &amp; server sync |\n| **Icons** | Lucide React | Beautiful icon library |\n| **Toasts** | Sonner | Notification system |\n\n### Backend &amp; Services Layer\n| Service | Provider | Purpose |\n|---------|----------|---------|\n| **Database** | Supabase (PostgreSQL) | User profiles, flashcards, study history |\n| **Authentication** | Clerk | User login, account management, webhook events |\n| **AI Engine** | OpenAI GPT-5 (Nano/Mini) | Dynamic difficulty adjustment |\n| **Serverless Functions** | Vercel Functions | Backend APIs (&#96;api/sync.ts&#96;) |\n| **Row Level Security** | Supabase RLS | Data protection by user |\n| **Real-time Sync** | Supabase Realtime | Live data updates (optional) |\n\n### Development Tools\n| Tool | Purpose |\n|------|---------|\n| **Package Manager** | npm / Bun | Dependency management |\n| **Testing** | Vitest + Playwright | Unit, integration, and E2E tests |\n| **Linting** | ESLint | Code quality |\n| **Formatting** | Prettier | Code consistency |\n| **Version Control** | Git | Repository management |\n\n---\n\n## Core Application Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ngulfara/\n├── src/                        # Frontend React ├── GulfaraLanding.tsx # Public landing page\n│   │   ├── Onboarding.tsx     # New user setup flow\n│   │   ├── Profile.tsx        # User profile &amp; statistics\n│   │   ├── Rewards.tsx        #   ├── Layout.tsx              # Main layout wrapper\n│   │   ├── Auth.jsx                # Auth integration with Clerk\n│   │   ├── auth/                   # Auth-related components\n│   │   └── ui/                     # Shadcn/Radix UI components\n│   │\n│   ├── services/              # Business Logic &amp; External APIs\n│   │   ├── aiAdapter.ts       # OpenAI integration (difficulty tuning)\n│ # Custom React Hooks\n│   │   ├── useEnsureProfile.ts     # Verify user profile exists\n│   │   ├── usePrefetchedDeck.ts    # Load deck data efficiently\n│   │   ├── use-toast.ts            # Toast Feature documentation\n├── DEPLOYMENT.md              # Deployment instructions\n└── ...other docs...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Core Features &amp; Functionality\n\n### 1. **Adaptive Difficulty System (AI-Powered)**\n- **What:** Real-time difficulty adjustment based on user performance\n- **How:** OpenAI GPT-5 Nano analyzes study performance, recommends difficulty level\n- **Cost:** ~$0.0005 per request (80 tokens, limited to $0.01/user max)\n- **Code:** &#96;services/aiAdapter.ts&#96;, &#96;services/costOptimizer.ts&#96;\n- **Impact:** Keeps learners in the \"zone of proximal development\"\n\n### 2. **Spaced Repetition System (SM-2 Algorithm)**\n- **What:** Smart scheduling of flashcards based on forgetting curve\n- **How:** Tracks performance, increases intervals for mastered cards, repeats difficult ones\n- **Code:** &#96;services/srsEngine.ts&#96;\n- **Science:** Proven to increase long-term retention by 50%+\n\n### 3. **Gamification &amp; Progression**\n- **Points System:** Earn XP for correct answers and streaks\n- **Achievement Badges:** Unlock milestones (e.g., \"7-day streak\")\n- **Reward Vouchers:** Trade points for real-world rewards\n- **Daily Streaks:** Bonus multipliers for consecutive days\n- **Code:** &#96;components/Dashboard.tsx&#96;, &#96;pages/Rewards.tsx&#96;\n\n### 4. **User Onboarding**\n- **What:** Guided first-run experience\n- **Collects:** Learning goals, language level, category preferences, personal info\n- **Code:** &#96;pages/Onboarding.tsx&#96;\n- **Impact:** Personalizes learning from day one\n\n### 5. **Multi-Category Learning**\n- **8 Categories:** Family, Work, Travel, Food, Shopping, Health, Education, Social\n- **20+ Flashcards:** Authentic Gulf Arabic phrases with audio hints\n- **Code:** &#96;content/flashcards.json&#96;, &#96;pages/DeckStudy.tsx&#96;\n\n### 6. **Interactive Flashcard UI**\n- **3D Flip Animation:** Framer Motion-powered card flip\n- **Dual-sided:** Arabic front, English/translation back\n- **Hints:** Cultural notes, usage examples, pronunciation audio (optional)\n- **Code:** &#96;components/GulfaraFlashcard.tsx&#96;\n\n### 7. **Analytics &amp; Progress Dashboard**\n- **Metrics Tracked:**\n  - Total cards mastered\n  - Current streak\n  - Category mastery %\n  - Weekly activity heatmap\n  - AI cost transparency\n- **Code:** &#96;pages/Dashboard.tsx&#96;, &#96;components/CostMonitor.tsx&#96;\n- **Charts:** Powered by Recharts\n\n### 8. **Multi-Language Support**\n- **Languages:** English (default) + Arabic (RTL support)\n- **Code:** &#96;contexts/LanguageContext.tsx&#96;\n- **Implementation:** Context-based language switching\n\n### 9. **Dark Mode / Theming**\n- **Code:** &#96;contexts/ThemeContext.tsx&#96;\n- **Implementation:** TailwindCSS dark class + CSS variables\n\n### 10. **Authentication &amp; User Management**\n- **Provider:** Clerk (handles signup, login, ## 📋 Summary of What Gulfara Is:
```

**Gulfara** is a **full-stack, AI-powered language learning platform** (not just frontend or backend—it's both):

### The Quick Version:
- **Type:** Interactive flashcard app for learning Gulf Arabic
- **Frontend:** React 18 + TypeScript + Vite (modern, responsive, beautiful UI)
- **Backend:** Serverless Node.js functions on Vercel + Supabase database
- **AI:** OpenAI integration for adaptive difficulty adjustment
- **Auth:** Clerk for user management
- **Features:** Gamification, spaced repetition (SM-2), analytics, dark mode, Arabic RTL support

```js
// filepath: gulfara/src/supabase/clientStandalone.js
// ...existing code...
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
export const getSupabaseClient = (token) => {
  const url = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;
  const client = createClient(url, key, {
    global: {
      fetch: (url, options) => fetch(url, options)
    }
  });
  if (token) client.auth.setAuth ? client.auth.setAuth(token) : null;
  return client;
};
```
